title: Use fields with any type
objective: Declare fields of different types, including lists and maps, and read a field inside an if or a say line.

body.text: Each has line in a structure gives one field and its type. A field can hold any type: a text, a number, a true or false value, a list, or a map. Read a field with its name and of, as in score of player, the same way as in data.structures.

body.title: Fields of several types
body.code:
structure scores
    has values of type a list of number

make s equal to a scores with values a list of 1, 2
say first of values of s

structure directory
    has entries of type a map from text to number

make d equal to a directory with entries a map from "a" to 1
make value equal to entries of d
say value at "a"

body.text: A field can be used in a condition too. Here the if compares the field with true, and the say runs only when it is true.

body.title: A field in a condition
body.code:
structure switch
    has enabled of type boolean

make s equal to a switch with enabled true
if enabled of s is equal to true
    say "on"

body.prompt: The program prints the room's description, but it should report the room's name instead. Make it print entrance.
body.starter:
structure room
    has name of type text
    has description of type text

make room equal to a room with name "entrance" and description "A hall"
say description of room
body.solution:
structure room
    has name of type text
    has description of type text

make room equal to a room with name "entrance" and description "A hall"
say name of room
